value.rationale: A natural missing-matching perturbation creates two isolated resonances and uniform finite-time stabilization. At n=5, the same 720 rare initial states reach the period-ten family for two distinct excitable rules but only 240 are recurrent under GH; the precise 24 versus 72 orbit contrast measures a nontrivial attractor/basin distinction beyond synchronization and activity theory. Complete graph-size spectrum and sharp finite-time bound are meaningful natural invariants.
